The Company has established a comprehensive Code of Conduct for its employees, which serves as a guiding framework for ethical behaviour, grievance resolution, and the maintenance of a positive and respectful work environment. Employees are encouraged to raise concerns or report issues affecting their workplace by approaching their reporting manager, Head of Department (HoD), or the Human Resources (HR) department. In addition, the Company has instituted a Vigil Mechanism / Whistle Blower Policy, under which any reported or suspected violations are subject to appropriate review and investigation. All matters disclosed during the investigation process are handled with strict confidentiality, except where disclosure is required for conducting the investigation or implementing remedial actions in compliance with applicable laws. To oversee compliance with the Code of Conduct, the Company has constituted a Code of Conduct Apex Committee comprising five members drawn from managerial and senior leadership positions. The Committee meets at least twice annually to monitor implementation of the Code and address instances of non‑compliance. It investigates complaints and grievances related to the Code and submits its recommendations to the management committee. An annual report on the implementation of the Code of Conduct is submitted to the management committee by 30 April each year for the preceding financial year. Further, the Company has implemented a policy to prevent, prohibit, and address sexual harassment at the workplace, in accordance with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. An Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) comprising six members and chaired by a senior woman employee has been constituted to investigate complaints related to sexual harassment. Employees may register complaints by approaching any ICC member or by emailing feelsafe@gtpl.net. All complaints are addressed and resolved within the timelines prescribed under the policy.
